notes.title: Blank Frame is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/26fcdf79998502623d33da55ffd52e98b8ce3f72.gif[/img]
[b]Blank Frame[/b] is a first person surreal horror game with a look akin to early 2000's pc/ps2 games developed by Through Tunnel. The game focuses on atmosphere and story instead of constantly startling the player with cheap and unnecessary jump scares.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kFLu68SWjqk
[b]👁️ SCREENSHOTS, CLICK! 👁️[/b]
[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/2aa59ff18dbbf4a43bb51081a5cd3a449c83135b.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/f98281c619022b07b219e6d38fcab45bcc621aaf.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/459d54db5073881464310795bba3912420ce045d.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/af41ee55ede0341ea7f83ab24ef658389b5e1524.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/308e1ed63df551b3135e0e080c62a6525e349b6b.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/e71de1f565d0cd2e392916faa23ae18f28a30094.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/7c009538fb40ee8bb76fba20325b667c1c08a21f.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/988db7f62d963e4d1c3d87680b88c2ee30c00bca.jpg[/img][/url]
In the small town of Dim River, Henri wakes up in the middle of the night to a sudden and loud noise. A strange metal cabinet has fallen through the ceiling from the apartment above, effectively blocking his front door. The night life of the town goes on, oblivious to Henri's struggles as he tries to solve his predicament, perhaps not completely on his own.

[b]The night is going to be long and peculiar...[/b]
